name: StressTestExercise
description: A PRA annual concurrent stress test exercise. Tracks the lifecycle from scenario loading through to PRA submission. Owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) as the system that runs the projections and owns the model outputs.

fields.name: exercise_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this stress test exercise

fields.name: exercise_year
fields.description: Calendar year of the PRA stress test (e.g. 2026)

fields.name: status
fields.description: pending | in_progress | projections_complete | approved_for_submission | submitted | closed

fields.name: triggered_by
fields.description: FK to PER-059 (CRO) who initiated the exercise

fields.name: scenarios_loaded_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when PRA scenarios were loaded

fields.name: projections_completed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when all model projections completed

fields.name: board_approved_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of Board Risk Committee sign-off

fields.name: cro_attestation_ref
fields.description: CRO attestation reference for submission sign-off

fields.name: pra_submission_ref
fields.description: PRA confirmation reference number from BEEDS portal

fields.name: projected_stressed_cet1_y1
fields.description: Projected CET1 ratio Year 1 under severe adverse scenario (%)

fields.name: projected_stressed_cet1_y2
fields.description: Projected CET1 ratio Year 2 under severe adverse scenario (%)

fields.name: projected_stressed_cet1_y3
fields.description: Projected CET1 ratio Year 3 under severe adverse scenario (%)

fields.name: model_validation_sign_off_ref
fields.description: Model validation sign-off reference per SS1/23

design_decisions: StressTestExercise owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) — risk projections are the core output and SVC-012 executes the models.

Projected CET1 ratios stored on StressTestExercise for the severe adverse scenario (the regulatory binding scenario). Full scenario outputs are stored in the model output data store, referenced by exercise_id.
